name: Sikafloor-050 Ramp and Patch
paste:
SIKAFLOOR®-050 RAMP AND PATCH: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sikafloor®-050 Ramp and Patch, April 2023, Version 01.03 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/2/sikafloor-050-rampandpatch.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sikafloor®-050 Ramp and Patch where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.03).
1.2 Product description. Sikafloor®-050 Ramp and Patch is a fast setting ramping / patching mortar used for internal & external concrete surfaces.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - Applied by its self, or part of a system with suitable materials from Sikafloor®, Sikadur® SikaBond®, SikaTite® & Davco® ranges
    - Ramping/grading to create a smooth transition between two types of flooring
    - Patching damaged concrete floors, stairs, & walls
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.7.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sikafloor®-050 Ramp and Patch
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: HIGH STRENGTH FAST SETTING RAMPING & PATCHING MORTAR
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates. Green Star (VOC-SCQMD Rule 1168)
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Very Low VOC (1 grams per litre)
    - Rapid drying
    - Internal & external applications
    - Non-combustible
    - Fast setting
    - Smooth flat surface is achievable
    - High early strength 24hrs = 28 - 30MPa
    - Walkable in as little as 40 - 50 minutes
    - Installation of flooring in 60-90 minutes
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Polymer modified cement mortar
    - Appearance and colour: Grey powder
2.5 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Compressive strength: 1 day cure ~ 30MPa; 28 day cure ~ 40MPa
    - Water absorption: Porous
    - Reaction to fire: No hazardous combustion products are known
2.6 System structure.
    | Porous Concrete | Very Porous Concrete | Non-porous Surface |
    | Sikafloor®-050 Ramp | Diluted Sikafloor® 01 | Sikafloor®-14 Prep N |
    | and Patch | Primer or Water | Prime |
    | Subsequent suitable | Sikafloor®-050 Ramp | Sikafloor®-050 Ramp |
    | materials | and Patch | and Patch |
    | Subsequent suitable | Subsequent suitable |
    | materials | materials |
    (System build-up table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows. Refer to the data sheet (page 2) for the layout.)
2.7 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 20kg Bag - 48 bags per pallet
    - Shelf life: Unopened bags can be stored for up to 9 months in a cool, dry and weatherproof environment.
    - Storage conditions: Bags must be stored off the floor. Avoid sitting bags in direct sunlight prior to application.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.03) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate quality / pre-treatment. Concrete floors should be fully cured, structurally sound, clean, dry, and free of surface contaminates and dust for Eg. Concrete must be porous and accept water penetration. Test by lightly sprinkling water on various areas of the substrate. If water penetrates, then a good bond with Sikafloor®-050 Ramp and Patch can be achieved. If water beads and fails to be absorbed by the concrete surface contaminants are present then loss of adhesion may occur. Contaminates that are present should be mechanically removed before installation. Concrete must be free of efflorescence and not subject to hydrostatic pressure. If the concrete substrate has efflorescence or high moisture (RH) and moisture sensitive flooring is being installed, Sikafloor® Moisture Barrier System may be considered (Sikafloor®-158 W Fast Barrier + Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime + Sikafloor®-050 Ramp and Patch). Contact your local Sika® office for further information.
3.3 Substrate quality / pre-treatment - Priming. A bond strength of >1.3MPa between Sikafloor®-050 Ramp and Patch to a smooth porous concrete surface can be achieved without the use of a primer. For optimal adhesion or if the concrete is extremely porous (mechanically prepared or broken concrete) a Sikafloor® Primer or pre-dampening with water may be considered. The use of a primer or wetting the surface with water enhances bond strength and reduce rapid moisture loss from mortar giving longer working time. See applications for further details.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.03) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Mixing ratio: 4 - 4.2 Litres of clean, cool water
    - Yield: 12L - 12mm @ 1m2
    - Layer thickness: 1 - 50mm
    - Pot Life: 15 minutes @ 23°C
    - Initial set time: 20 minutes @ 23°C
    - Final set time: 25 minutes @ 23°C
    - Waiting time to overcoating: Allow 60 – 90 minutes at 23°C prior to subsequent applications
4.3 Equipment. High speed heavy duty electric drill and mixing paddle. Suitable size bucket/vessel - 20L +
4.4 Mixing. Mix the entire 20kg bag of powder with 4.1 - 4.3 Litres of clean, cool water. Slowly add powder to the water while mixing with a suitable electric drill and mixing paddle. Thoroughly mix for only 1 minutes to a lump free consistency and apply directly. Not mixing for the recommended time or additional water may result in product irregularities and possible product failure.
4.5 Application. Using Sikafloor®-050 Ramp and Patch prior to floor coverings:
4.6 Application - Ramping.
    - Once product is mixed immediately apply and begin working to heights required. Product can be worked/shaped/shaved with the back of a trowel up to 20 minutes after application.
    - Using Sikafloor®-050 Ramp and Patch to repair concrete:
    - Patching concrete
    - On a well prepared clean and roughened concrete surface a bonding primer is generally not required, but pre-dampening of the surface with water is recommended. After water has been applied and allowed to soak the concrete surface should achieve a dark matt appearance without glistening and surface pores and pits shall not contain water. The surface shall not be allowed to completely dry before application of Sikafloor®-050 Ramp and Patch. If priming is preferred first diluted Sikafloor® 01 Primer 1:3 with water then apply by way of a brush till all areas have been coated and allow to dry. Once placed, a trowel is used to pack & shape Sikafloor®- 050 Ramp and Patch into the concrete void. Sikafloor®-050 Ramp and Patch can also be left high of the finished surface required and shaved using the trowel until full set. Working time 15 - 20 min @ 23°C. Note: Freshly applied Sikafloor®-050 Ramp and Patch must be protected from damp, condensation and all forms of water while curing for at least 24 hours.
4.7 Limitations and important considerations - Limitations.
    - Do not install Sikafloor®-050 Ramp and Patch over particleboard, hardwood floors, parquet floors or metal.
    - Do not mix or apply Sikafloor®-050 Ramp and Patch in temperatures below 10°C and above 35°C and under hot and windy conditions.
    - Keep product cool prior to mixing and do not leave bags in direct sun for extended periods.
    - Protect from hot or strong winds and extremes of temperature for 12hrs after being applied to avoid rapid moisture loss leading to cracking or crazing.
    - All construction/expansion joints in existing concrete must be reflected through Sikafloor product as soon as possible to do so.
    - Not recommended as a trafficable surface.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature. 10°C - 35°C
5.3 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.7):
    - Do not mix or apply Sikafloor®-050 Ramp and Patch in temperatures below 10°C and above 35°C and under hot and windy conditions.
    - Protect from hot or strong winds and extremes of temperature for 12hrs after being applied to avoid rapid moisture loss leading to cracking or crazing.
5.4 Basis of the stated values.
    - Manufactured in Australia.
    - All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sikafloor®-050 Ramp and Patch, April 2023, Version 01.03, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/2/sikafloor-050-rampandpatch.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sikafloor®-050 Ramp and Patch, version 01/10/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/d/sds-sikafloor-050rampandpatch.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety - Cleaning. Clean tools and equipment with warm water and detergent while the product is still wet.
6.3 Ecology, health and safety - Health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall referto the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containingphysical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-re-lated data.
6.4 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.5 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.6 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
